name: Tamsin & Pike Bookkeeping
tagline: Bookkeeping for Bristol's small traders, kept in plain columns
description: A two-person bookkeeping practice in central Bristol. We keep the books for sole traders, market stalls and small limited companies, and hand over figures you can read at the kitchen table.
hours_note: Visits by appointment. Phone and email are answered in office hours.

services.name: Monthly bookkeeping
services.for: Sole traders and small limited companies
services.rhythm: Every month, books closed by the 10th

services.name: VAT returns
services.rhythm: Every quarter, filed before the deadline

services.name: Year-end pack
services.rhythm: Once a year, within four weeks of year end

services.name: Catch-up and clean-up
services.rhythm: One-off project, scoped on a call

services.name: Payroll for up to five people
services.rhythm: Every month, payslips two days before payday

month.what: You send receipts and bank access. A shared folder or a photo from your phone is fine.
We match, categorise and chase anything we cannot place.
You get a one-page summary: what came in, what went out, what you owe.

facts.pricing: A fixed monthly fee, agreed after a free 30-minute call. No price list: every set of books is different.
